stem: Sonia's list of marks has mean $60$. She inserts the three new marks $50$, $60$, and $70$ together.

statements.text: The inserted marks average $60$, so their total distance below the mean equals their total distance above it.
The mean of the list stays $60$ after the three marks are inserted together.
The mean must change because three new marks were added, regardless of their values.

teacher.key_rationale: 50, 60, 70 average to 60, balancing −10 and +10 about the existing mean, so the mean stays 60. Statement 3 wrongly forces a change from mere insertion. Key is 1 and 2 only.
